definitions.explanation: An open sore that develops on the inner lining of the stomach, causing pain, nausea, and other digestive symptoms. Often associated with stress, irregular eating habits, or bacterial infection.

examples.japanese: {胃潰瘍|いかいよう}と{診断|しんだん}された。
examples.english: I was diagnosed with a stomach ulcer.

examples.japanese: ストレスが{原因|げんいん}で{胃潰瘍|いかいよう}になった。
examples.english: I developed a stomach ulcer due to stress.

examples.japanese: {胃潰瘍|いかいよう}の{治療|ちりょう}には{薬|くすり}を{飲|の}みながら{食事|しょくじ}にも{気|き}をつける{必要|ひつよう}がある。
examples.english: Treating a stomach ulcer requires taking medication while also being careful about what you eat.

notes:
Composed of {胃|い} (stomach) and {潰瘍|かいよう} (ulcer). A common medical condition in Japan, historically attributed to overwork and stress, making this a word many adult Japanese speakers encounter in daily life.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {胃潰瘍|いかいよう}になる: to develop a stomach ulcer
- {胃潰瘍|いかいよう}の{治療|ちりょう}: treatment of a stomach ulcer
- {胃潰瘍|いかいよう}の{薬|くすり}: stomach ulcer medication
- {胃潰瘍|いかいよう}が{再発|さいはつ}する: stomach ulcer recurs

RELATED WORDS:
- {十二指腸潰瘍|じゅうにしちょうかいよう}: duodenal ulcer — ulcer in the duodenum, often discussed alongside stomach ulcers
- {胃炎|いえん}: gastritis — inflammation of the stomach lining, less severe
- {胃|い}カメラ: gastroscopy — the endoscopic procedure used to diagnose stomach ulcers
- ピロリ{菌|きん}: H. pylori — the bacterium that causes many ulcers
